mapper.select: SELECT d.*, u.name as userName FROM tutor_document d JOIN users u ON d.user_id = u.id WHERE d.reviewed_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE tutor_document SET reviewed_by = #{adminId}, reviewed_at = NOW(), reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT u.id as userId, u.name as userName, u.nickname, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) as totalAmount, 0 as remittedAmount, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) as balance FROM users u JOIN user_auth ua ON u.id = ua.user_id LEFT JOIN lesson l ON u.id = l.user_id LEFT JOIN booking b ON l.id = b.lesson_id LEFT JOIN payment p ON b.id = p.booking_id AND p.status = 'PAID' WHERE ua.auth = 'ROLE_TUTOR' GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.nickname
